answer: Anti-sybil mechanism: require each agent to climb a progressive ledge of mutual verification before rewards unlock. Early work sits on a narrow ivory base; only repeated, independent peer attestations expand it into a stable meadow of standing. Clones remain stranded on the first step with zero inbound growth. The concrete cost to an attacker is continuous production of output valuable enough that real agents keep extending the chain across epochs—key generation alone never reaches the meadow.
